empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a reusable block of reviewer instructions. Create one, or import a .md / .zip.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit, preview, and see its stats and history.

card.footer: {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · {pull} pull · {accept} accept

trust.title: Imported skill — someone else's instructions
trust.body: An imported skill is text written by someone else that goes straight into the agent's system prompt. Read it before you enable it. It is stored disabled and never executed.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteConfirm.body: This removes the skill and its version history. It is unlinked from every agent.
deleteConfirm.noAgents: No agent uses it right now.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionPlaceholder: When a PR adds a branch, require a test that asserts it.
config.descriptionHint: Write it as a directive: when the agent should apply this skill and what it must do
config.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what the reviewer must check…
config.changeNotePlaceholder: What changed? (optional, becomes the version message)

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Rendered exactly as the reviewing agent receives it, including unsaved edits.

stats.noAgents: No agent has this skill enabled.
stats.noFindings: No findings from runs that included this skill in the last 30 days.
stats.correlational: Correlational: these are findings from runs that included this skill. It doesn't mean the skill caused them.

versions.title: Versions
versions.diffSubtitle: Line diff of the skill body

restoreConfirm.title: Restore v{version}?
restoreConfirm.body: This creates a new version (v{next}) with v{version}'s content. History is kept.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: From a .md file or a .zip containing SKILL.md
import.ignoredHint: Only the skill text is kept. These files from the archive are ignored.
import.savedToast: Imported “{name}”. It stays disabled until you enable it.
